tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground behind every section.

tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: Pinned top bar and secondary buttons that sit over the helix; always with a 16px backdrop blur.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Resting cards: sample cards, chat panel, textarea fill.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Segmented-tab track, neutral count chips, disabled button fill.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Floating panels (upload panel, result card) over busy grounds; pair with a 22px backdrop blur and a `line` border.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, body copy and icons on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-2` and `glass` (17:1).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Supporting paragraphs, nav links and checkbox labels on `bg` and `surface` (9.5:1 dark, 7.9:1 light).

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Meta text: units, ranges, mono captions, idle step labels on `bg`, `surface` and `surface-2` (≥4.8:1 both themes).

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: The grey second half of a display headline and marquee slashes. Text 24px and larger only (3.8:1 dark, 3.2:1 light).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and card borders. Decorative; never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of outline pills, round icon buttons, dashed drop zones and inputs.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The violet. Primary-action fill (Analyze), active step dot, focus ring, arrows, marquee highlights. Never body text in light (use `accent-ink`).

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Accent-coloured text: eyebrows, inline links, the 'browse' link on `bg`, `surface` and `glass` (11:1 dark, 6.3:1 light).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fills: icon tiles, assistant chat bubbles, drop-zone hover.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent` fill (8.1:1 dark, 5.2:1 light).

tokens.name: solid
tokens.usage: High-contrast pill fill: the hero CTA, selected tab, user chat bubble, 'Try it' chips.

tokens.name: on-solid
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `solid` fill.

tokens.name: solid-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for `solid` buttons; text stays `on-solid-hover`.

tokens.name: on-solid-hover
tokens.usage: Text on `solid-hover`.

tokens.name: flag-high-bg
tokens.usage: HIGH flag chip and '2 high' count chip fill.

tokens.name: flag-high-fg
tokens.usage: HIGH flag text on `flag-high-bg` (9.2:1 dark, 5.9:1 light). Orange, so it never relies on red/green alone.

tokens.name: flag-normal-bg
tokens.usage: NORMAL flag chip fill.

tokens.name: flag-normal-fg
tokens.usage: NORMAL flag text on `flag-normal-bg` (11:1 dark, 6.1:1 light).

tokens.name: flag-low-bg
tokens.usage: LOW flag chip fill.

tokens.name: flag-low-fg
tokens.usage: LOW flag text on `flag-low-bg` (8.4:1 dark, 6.3:1 light). Blue against HIGH's orange: tellable apart by lightness and hue.

tokens.name: status-ok
tokens.usage: The 'ONLINE' dot in the top bar; always beside the word.

tokens.name: status-warn
tokens.usage: The pulsing 'STARTING UP' dot while the backend wakes; always beside the word.

tokens.name: dot-idle
tokens.usage: Inactive timeline dots and carousel pager dots.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: Halo ring around the active timeline dot.

tokens.name: foot-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of the giant faded footer wordmark gradient (fades into `bg`).

tokens.name: preview-bg
tokens.usage: The results-preview band only: the faint radial glow of `accent` and `helix-cyan` over the ground (README, 'Colour'). A paint value, not a flat colour, so it is used as `background`, never as `color`.

tokens.name: helix-violet
tokens.usage: Top of the particle helix gradient. Decorative graphic only.

tokens.name: helix-cyan
tokens.usage: Bottom of the particle helix gradient. Decorative graphic only.
